parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the main teachings from Qur’an 17.35.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain how the Prophet (pbuh) kept the promises he made to others. You must refer to
Hadith 199 and any other Hadith or verse from the Qur’an that you have studied.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘In modern times, it is hard for Muslims to keep to the principles of Islam when interacting with
others.’ Discuss this statement with reference to different points of view. 
EITHER

text: Read the following text passages then answer the questions which follow.
Give full measure when ye measure, and weigh with a balance that is straight: that is the most
fitting and the most advantageous in the final determination.
Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
Messenger of Allah (ملسو هيلع هللا ىلص) said, “There are three signs of a hypocrite: When he speaks, he lies;
when he makes a promise, he breaks it; and when he is trusted, he betrays his trust.” [Al‑Bukhari

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the importance of Ramadan for Muslims.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Fasting in Ramadan is equally as important as a physical act as it is a spiritual act.’ Evaluate
this statement. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Examine the importance of the birth rituals for Muslim families.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Physical purification helps Muslims to go to paradise (jannah).’ Evaluate this statement.
